verdict.rationale: Gusto runs an official remote MCP server (mcp.api.gusto.com) that lets users reach their own Gusto data in natural language from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini, using OAuth and scoped access. It also ships an agent-friendly CLI with an AGENTS.md and bundled skills (payroll-prep, timesheet-sync, cash-forecasting), so per-cycle payroll prep can be driven from a single agent chat session. Evidence that the MCP connection supports actions beyond data access is thin, and the CLI can only draft payroll; it has no run/submit command. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language assistant, documented write/action coverage via the MCP server, end-to-end operation including payroll submission, independent or hands-on corroboration.
